fields.label: Location
fields.note: Free-text box name=locationsearch on /search/; the widget posts it as the 'location' body field.

notes: The official entry redirects to careers.wipro.com; /search/ renders the SuccessFactors CSB search widget with a keyword box (name=q) and a free-text location box (name=locationsearch). The widget POSTs {locale, pageNumber, sortBy, keywords, location, facetFilters, ...} to /services/recruiting/v1/jobs. Live POSTs confirmed both filters: location=India returned totalJobs 5656, keywords=engineer plus location=United States returned 276 rows whose jobLocationCountry is United States. The page exposes no department, employment-type or workplace facets, so none are declared; sortBy exists in the widget config but no sort options are rendered.
